verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.preview: One click to confirm your Upvine account.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up for Upvine. Please confirm your email address so we can keep your account secure.
verifyEmail.expires: This link is valid for {{ttl}} hours.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn't create an Upvine account, you can safely ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Upvine password
resetPassword.preview: Use this link to choose a new password.
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Upvine account.
resetPassword.expires: This link is valid for {{ttl}} minutes.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

articleReady.subject: An article is waiting for your approval
articleReady.heading: Your new article is ready
articleReady.body: We finished “{{title}}”. The facts are checked and the SEO score is ready. Please review it and approve it for publishing.
articleReady.expires: Nothing is published without your approval.
articleReady.ignore: You receive this email because your site publishes in approval mode. You can change this in Settings.

freeAnalysis.subject: Your free SEO analysis for {{domain}}
freeAnalysis.heading: Your site analysis is ready
freeAnalysis.body: Here is the report for {{domain}}. Site health score: {{score}} / 100. The report shows what to fix first and which topics your customers search for.
freeAnalysis.expires: The report link stays valid for 30 days.
freeAnalysis.ignore: You receive this email because you asked for it on Upvine. We will not send marketing emails unless you agreed to them.
